remarks: Discover a rare opportunity to own this light-filled and versatile one-level ranch with a fully finished walk-out lower level-perfect for a young adult suite, nanny or in-law. Thoughtfully designed for flexibility and comfort, this home offers 5 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, including brand-new stainless steel appliances in the eat-in kitchen. Enjoy the warmth of the fireplace in the living room, freshly painted interiors, and plenty of natural light throughout. Outdoor living is just as inviting, with two private patios and a level, usable yard-ideal for entertaining and relaxing.  A standout feature of this property is its two separate and private driveways, 2 kitchens, providing convenience and plenty of privacy for multi-generational living or guests. Located in a highly desirable in-town neighborhood, this home is just a 15-minute walk to the town and train station, and only 20 minutes on foot to New Canaan's award-winning public schools.
